description: List AI-agent processes actually running right now (Claude Code, Codex, Aider, ...). Separates terminal-attached sessions (a human can see them) from detached/orphan ones. Reads ps/lsof directly — never transcripts or docs. Patterns configurable via WR_AGENT_PATTERNS.

include_detached.description: Also list background/orphan agent processes with no terminal (default true)

name: agent_sessions
